decisions.reason: The candidate already uses the latest reference script as its foundation. Combining benefits from two scripts changes messaging content, not the established creative-direction state.
The source changes reference and benefit sources but does not change the requirement that the script and previews be in Hindi.
The instruction does not alter the audience age range or Indian-market context.
The source specifies how benefits and reference messaging should be combined but does not necessarily replace the testimonial presentation or its independently created material.
The source contains no instruction changing or removing the integrated call to action.
Using the latest reference and combining benefits does not change the existing direct, Indian-market-aligned hook requirement.
The source changes messaging inputs but does not alter the requirement for a viral creative style.
Reference-aligned benefit messaging has no necessary effect on lip-sync accuracy or facial-expression requirements.
The source does not change responsibility for supplying the script, visuals, voiceover, or raw production inputs.
The source concerns script messaging and does not resolve or modify the production-method conflict involving live-action and AI-generated scenes.
Mentioning the winner script as a benefit source does not change the conversion objective, CPL target, or optimization priority.
The messaging revision does not alter video counts, duration, formats, pilot sequencing, or follow-on ordering conditions.
